verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Voice Agent runtime only as Deepgram's hosted WebSocket API, offered at Deepgram-run regional endpoints (EU, AU, India). The open-source GitHub starters are client template apps that call this API. Pipecat and LiveKit are third-party frameworks that use Deepgram models, not Deepgram's agent runtime, so nothing shows the runtime itself is open-source or self-hostable.
